subject: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodai.com>
To: Adam Liu <adam@eventtech.io>, Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudstack-expo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping

Hi Adam / Sonia,

Quick note as we lock down logistics for CloudStack (Nov 3–5): we want to use your on-booth tap-to-capture units (the BL-900s) to ingest leads into HubSpot in near-real time, but we have a few constraints:

- Consent language must be display-first (GDPR/CPRA friendly) and captured as a boolean on each lead.
- Fields required in CRM: first/last, work email, company, role, opt_in_consent, event_source=cloudstack_2025_boothB, product_interest (multi).
- We need a mapping CSV from the device payload keys to HubSpot properties (and the fallback behavior for missing email).
- Staging sync to our sandbox HubSpot account first (no production writes until Tuesday of show week).

Adam, can your feed emit opt_in_consent as a top-level flag and include the device_id and timestamp? Sonia, is EventOrg able to surface the mandatory consent banner on the entrance to our booth (we'll also show one on the tablet)?

Cc'ing Marissa and Grace to align on HubSpot mapping and consent copy. Goal: test end-to-end in sandbox by Oct 28.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Adam Liu <adam@eventtech.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping

Diego — thanks for the context. Confirmations: 

- BL-900 will emit a JSON payload with device_id, scanned_id (if badge), free_text_email (if typed), detected_email (OCR), first_name, last_name, company, role, interests[].
- We can include a boolean opt_in_consent and a consent_version string (e.g., v1.2) in the payload.
- We can stream to an HTTP endpoint (webhook) in near-real time and batch-deliver CSVs as a backup.

Two asks from our side before we enable production sync:
1) Provide the exact HubSpot property names you want mapped (or the CSV mapping).
2) Confirm sandbox API keys + a test endpoint (we'll point to your sandbox URL).

I'll attach our device payload spec and a sample webhook delivery. If you want, we can stand up a short smoke-test on Wed 10/22.

—Adam
Adam Liu
Integrations Lead, EventTech
attachments: eventtech-bl900-payload-spec.pdf (stub)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Adam Liu <adam@eventtech.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudstack-expo.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping

Marissa / Tessa — please take point on the mapping and sandbox connection. Specifics:

- HubSpot properties we need: email, firstname, lastname, company, jobtitle, opt_in_consent (boolean), consent_version, event_source, product_interest (multi-select), redwood_device_id, lead_source_detail.
- If device returns both detected_email and free_text_email, prefer free_text_email first, fall back to detected_email. If neither, create a placeholder lead with company+role and add a task to follow up.
- Attachments: I'm expecting a CSV mapping + a consent banner PNG from Marketing.
- Timeline: please confirm staged webhook endpoint by EOD Thu 10/16 and a smoke test slot (30 mins) with Adam on 10/22 or 10/23.

If you need to push any of this to the legal/compliance folks for wording, loop them in — Grace, could you review the consent copy once Marissa has a draft?

Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Adam Liu <adam@eventtech.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 17:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping

Thanks — taking this on. Quick updates:

- Attached is lead-field-mapping-v2.csv (first column = device key, second = HubSpot property, third = fallback logic). Please review and confirm gaps.
- I've requested sandbox API keys from Integrations; should have them by 10/15.
- For placeholder leads (no email) we'll set contact.email = "unknown+{device_id}@redwood-infer.com" and add a note: "Follow-up: confirm email from business card / onsite."

Adam: please confirm your webhook will include consent_version and that it will retain the timestamp in ISO8601. Also confirm whether batch CSV backups include the same fields and are available within 2 hours.

Attaching: lead-field-mapping-v2.csv (CSV stub).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Growth Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: lead-field-mapping-v2.csv (stub)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudstack-expo.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 20:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Expo booth lead ingest — capture device + consent + CRM mapping

Thanks team — looked over Marissa's mapping. Two quick edits on consent language (we'll surface these in the atrium banner + on the capture tablet):

1) Short form for banner: "By tapping to receive product updates and event materials from Redwood Inference, you consent to storage of your contact details and marketing communication. Manage preferences anytime at privacy.redwood.ai"
2) Consent checkbox copy for tablet (explicit): "I agree to receive emails about product updates, events, and partner offers from Redwood Inference. I understand I can opt out at any time."

Marissa — please add consent_version = "2025-10-13-v1" in the CSV and include opt_in_source ("booth_tablet" | "on_booth_banner").

Sonia — thanks in advance for the banner placement confirmation. If EventOrg can place the banner near the two main entrances to the expo hall, that covers the support ask.

I'll coordinate with Legal if they want to tweak legalese, but this language has been approved in prior shows.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
